sprint.name: Technical Debt & Quality Improvements
sprint.objective: Address technical debt from Phase 3 and Phase 4, improve code quality, and ensure comprehensive test coverage

remaining_items: Full test suite execution fix (architectural issue)

parallel_execution.strategy: Independent technical debt items can run in parallel

work_streams.name: Test Suite Execution Fix
work_streams.issue: Full test suite times out when running all 47 files together (>5 min). Individual files pass in 16-20s.
work_streams.root_cause: Suspected vitest worker process memory leak or module caching issue
deliverables: Profile worker processes to identify bottleneck
Execute full suite successfully with HTML coverage report
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite completes in <5 minutes

work_streams.name: TypeScript Strict Mode Cleanup
work_streams.issue: 242 'any' type usages across codebase, particularly in Fleet.tsx and test mocks
deliverables: Replace all 'any' types in Fleet.tsx with proper Agent interface
Define proper interfaces for WebSocket event payloads
Add explicit types to reduce accumulator parameters

work_streams.name: Enhanced Error Handling
work_streams.issue: Missing error boundaries, insufficient try-catch blocks, no fallback UI for failures
deliverables: Create ErrorBoundary component with fallback UI
Add try-catch to event handlers in Events, Fleet, CFNLoop
Add error state to all views (error, setError)
Add fallback UI for WebSocket disconnection
acceptance_criteria: Error state implemented in all views
Try-catch blocks in all async operations

work_streams.name: E2E Test Execution
work_streams.issue: 32 E2E Playwright tests created but not executed (require running dev server)
deliverables: Fix any failures in test expectations
